name: Image Link Formatter
description: Extends Core 'image' formatter to allow displaying images wrapped within a link provided by a field.

suggests.drupal/link_attributes: Very flexible module, allowing to add more attributes to a Link field, such as 'rel' or '_target', that could be displayed through the Image Link Formatter.
suggests.drupal/link_target: Smaller and simpler module, allowing to add a '_target' attribute to a Link field, that could be displayed through the Image Link Formatter.
suggests.drupal/paragraphs: Allows building Paragraphs with Image and Link fields, that could be displayed through the Image Link Formatter.
